spec_case: issue #403: a member-access chain past Circuitry's own recursion budget for this shape, through the CLI's own real call depth
description: A 613-link member-access chain fails cof itself before the document ever runs: path collection walks the whole parse tree once per '.' link with no recursion guard, raising a RecursionError so close to Python's own limit, at the CLI's own real call depth, that even core/cel_eval.py::_compile's RecursionError catch (issue #629) can itself re-trigger a second one while handling the first -- cof's own text for this exact edge-of-the-limit case stays the bare, call-context-dependent one #629 fixes everywhere else. electricity-cel has no comparable edge: MAX_ACCESSOR_NESTING_DEPTH is a deterministic pre-scan with no recursion of its own to re-trigger, so its own rejection for this shape is always the clean, located text now (c629-cel-nested-too-deep covers a shape -- deep parens, not a long accessor chain -- where cof's own catch has room to spare and both engines already agree). Python-only until cof's own remaining edge case is closed.
